_comment_top: Parameter template for the first supervised low-speed HIL ground diagnostic (a bounded, exclusionary diagnostic test, NOT a formal navigation trial and NOT the formal shared-exit experiment). Deliberately a SEPARATE file from hil_frozen_params.json: it never modifies that file's formal frozen evidence, and it scopes only the small geometry set this one straight-line diagnostic actually needs (start pose, travel direction, a stop line, and boundary clearance), not the full shared-exit arena/exit/parking/search-waypoint geometry. Any field whose value is not yet backed by a real measurement is the literal string 'UNCONFIRMED_PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT'. This file holds only TRACKED configuration -- measured geometry and stable venue facts -- checked via hil_preflight.check_required_fields_ready() against required_before_ground_motion below. Per-session runtime confirmations (floor condition, travel path clear, operator present, Wi-Fi checked) are NOT in this file; they live in a separate, gitignored session-state file managed by hil_ground_diagnostic_session.py, checked independently every run. run_ground_diagnostic_preflight.sh runs two explicit phases -- pre-stack and live-zero-state -- combining this file's tracked-field check with the session-state check and, in the live-zero-state phase only, live ROS-graph/evidence facts that cannot exist before the physical stack is started.

reused_frozen_reference._comment: Read-only references to already-confirmed values recorded elsewhere. Never duplicated as separately-editable numbers here, and never re-derived or re-measured -- copied for traceability only.
reused_frozen_reference.guard_hard_linear_cap_source: hil_frozen_params.json hil_guard_limits.max_linear_speed_mps (confirmed, unchanged by this diagnostic)
reused_frozen_reference.suspended_wheel_angular_value_excluded_n: angular_suspension_diagnostic_20260723/SUMMARY.md's temporary +-0.1 rad/s value is explicitly NOT reused here or anywhere in this diagnostic -- ground angular motion is prohibited for this first test (see diagnostic_command_limits.angular_speed_prohibited below), and that suspended-wheel value has never been and must never be written into hil_frozen_params.json's max_angular_speed_rps as a ground limit.

diagnostic_command_limits._comment: Reuses hil_wheel_suspension_test.py exactly as already built and tested for the suspended-wheel diagnostic -- no new pulse-generation mechanism. angular is not a tunable field here: it is fixed at 0.0 and prohibited, enforced independently by both this file and hil_cmd_vel_guard.py's own --max-angular-speed-rps 0.0 CLI argument at runbook execution time.

measured_geometry._comment: The minimum geometry this straight-line diagnostic needs -- deliberately smaller than hil_frozen_params.json's field_geometry (no exit/parking/search-waypoint fields; this test never approaches or searches for an exit). All UNCONFIRMED until the field-measurement form is completed. No minimum dimension or threshold is asserted anywhere in this file -- these are recorded measurements only, never compared against an invented number.

environment._comment: boundaries_and_obstacles_recorded is a STABLE fact about the fixed test venue (the recorded locations of walls/obstacles do not change session to session), so it stays tracked here. floor_condition_confirmed and travel_path_clear_confirmed are NOT here -- both can genuinely change between sessions (something spilled, an object left in the path), so re-checking them once and committing the result as permanently true was an execution-time safety gap: a stale committed value would be read as confirmed forever after, with no actual re-check that day. Moved 2026-07-24 to the gitignored per-session state file (hil_ground_diagnostic_session.py), defaulting false every session -- see FIELD_MEASUREMENT_FORM.md and GROUND_DIAGNOSTIC_RUNBOOK.md's FLOOR_CONDITION_CLEAR=YES / TRAVEL_PATH_CLEAR=YES same-session confirmations.

safety._comment: emergency_stop_position_confirmed records a stable fact about the fixed venue (where the e-stop/operator position is relative to the test area), so it stays tracked here. operator_present_confirmed is NOT here -- a person's presence is true only for the current session and must never be committed as a permanent fact; it lives in the gitignored session-state file (hil_ground_diagnostic_session.py) and defaults false every session. Distinct from and in addition to the verbal, per-session USER_AT_EMERGENCY_STOP=YES/TEST_AREA_CLEAR=YES confirmations already required elsewhere.

_comment_required_before_ground_motion: This list covers only TRACKED configuration -- stable venue facts and measured geometry (10 paths). It intentionally excludes floor_condition_confirmed, travel_path_clear_confirmed, operator_present_confirmed, and wifi_checked_in_test_area: all four are per-session runtime confirmations, genuinely re-checkable every run, checked separately via hil_ground_diagnostic_session.py's gitignored session-state file, never via this tracked file. A tracked-file value can never substitute for a session-file confirmation.
